title: 机场值机
subtitle_en: I'd like to check in for my flight.
goal_text: 在值机柜台办登机牌、选座、托运行李，并问一句有没有更早一班。
brief_cn: 值机是几分钟内说五六句话的场面。这一课把短句练熟：报航班、要过道座位、说几件行李、问托运费、最后一句“有更早的班吗”。柜员语速快，你也能接住。

vocab.example_en: I'd like to check in for my flight.
Can I have an aisle seat?
Do I go straight to the gate?

briefing.ref_text: I'd like to check in for my flight.
briefing.accept_notes: check in 连读，for my flight 轻带过去。

briefing.ref_text: Can I have an aisle seat near the front?
briefing.translation_cn: 可以给我一个靠前的过道座位吗？
briefing.accept_notes: aisle 的 s 不发音，读 /aɪl/。

briefing.cn_prompt: 听一遍，用自己的话说出行李和费用的问题。
briefing.ref_text: I have two bags to check. Is there an extra charge?
briefing.translation_cn: 我有两件行李要托运。有额外费用吗？
briefing.reference_answer: Two bags to check, and asking if there is an extra charge.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 two bags to check 并问到 extra charge 即算通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：确认登机牌到手。
briefing.reference_answer: Do I have my boarding pass?
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 boarding pass 即算通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：问有没有更早一班。
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 earlier flight 即算通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 用 aisle 说你要一个过道座位。
briefing.accept_notes: 先读对 aisle /aɪl/（s 不发音），再说出座位要求。

mission.persona_cn: 值机柜台员工，手上在打单，说话快
mission.context_cn: 早上八点的国际值机柜台。柜员会连着问护照、航班号、座位偏好、行李件数，最后一件是你主动开口：能不能改到更早一班。
mission.opening_a: Good morning. May I see your passport, please?

exchanges.a: Good morning. May I see your passport, please?
exchanges.b: Sure. I'd like to check in for my flight to London.
exchanges.b_cn: 好的，我想办一下去伦敦的值机。

exchanges.a: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
exchanges.b: Can I have an aisle seat near the front?
exchanges.a_cn: 您想要靠窗座位还是过道座位？
exchanges.b_cn: 可以给我一个靠前的过道座位吗？

exchanges.a: I have a 12A for you. Do you have bags to check?
exchanges.b: I have two bags to check.
exchanges.a_cn: 12A 可以吗？有行李要托运吗？

exchanges.a: The first bag is free. The second bag has an extra charge.
exchanges.b: How much is the extra charge?
exchanges.a_cn: 第一件行李免费。第二件行李有额外费用。

exchanges.a: That's fifty dollars. Here's your boarding pass.
exchanges.b: Thanks. Do I go straight to the gate?
exchanges.a_cn: 五十美元。这是您的登机牌。
exchanges.b_cn: 谢谢。我直接去登机口吗？

exchanges.a: Yes. Your gate is B7. Boarding starts at nine twenty.
exchanges.b: Is there an earlier flight? I have a meeting at noon.
exchanges.a_cn: 是的。登机口 B7，九点二十开始登机。
exchanges.b_cn: 有更早一班吗？我中午有个会。

exchanges.a: There's one at ten thirty. Do you want to switch?
exchanges.b: Yes, please. Can I take that one?
exchanges.a_cn: 十点半有一班。要改过去吗？

tasks.desc_cn: 开口说明来办值机，并报出航班
tasks.hint_en: I'd like to check in for my flight.
tasks.hint_cn: 报不出航班号就说 my flight to + 城市。

tasks.desc_cn: 要一个靠前的过道座位
tasks.hint_en: Can I have an aisle seat near the front?
tasks.hint_cn: aisle seat + near the front，两个要求一句说完。

tasks.desc_cn: 说清两件托运行李，并问要不要加钱
tasks.hint_en: I have two bags to check. Is there an extra charge?
tasks.hint_cn: 先报件数，再问 extra charge。

tasks.desc_cn: 询问是否有更早的航班
tasks.hint_cn: 加一句 I have a meeting at noon. 更容易改成。
